values.content: {"description":"Render ONE IRPT export: read the frozen ExportBundle from S3, open the counterpart's print route in Chromium, write the PDF and the network guard log back under the bound firm's exports prefix. NOT a vendor call: the only origin opened is the Opal portal origin, and a vendor origin is refused before the browser opens.","mainSteps":[{"action":"aws:runShellScript","inputs":{"runCommand":["set -euo pipefail","echo '--- deploy ---'","sudo mkdir -p /opt/investor-reporting-export","sudo chown -R $(id -u):$(id -g) /opt/investor-reporting-export || true","aws s3 cp s3://opal-313476888478-lambda-artifacts/ec2/investor-reporting-export/ /opt/investor-reporting-export/ --recursive --region us-east-1","ls -la /opt/investor-reporting-export","echo '--- host preflight ---'","node --version || echo 'BLOCKED: no node on this host'","echo '--- renderer module discovery ---'","ls -d /opt/*/node_modules 2\u003e/dev/null || echo 'none: /opt/*/node_modules'","npm root -g 2\u003e/dev/null || echo 'none: npm root -g'","find /opt /root /usr/lib/node_modules /usr/local/lib/node_modules -maxdepth 5 -type d -name 'playwright*' 2\u003e/dev/null | head -20 || true","python3 -c \"import playwright, os; print('python playwright at', os.path.dirname(playwright.__file__))\" 2\u003e/dev/null || echo 'none: python playwright'","for d in $(find /opt /root /usr/lib/node_modules /usr/local/lib/node_modules -maxdepth 6 -type d -name playwright 2\u003e/dev/null | head -5); do p=$(dirname \"$d\"); echo \"OK: node playwright under $p\"; export NODE_PATH=\"$p:${NODE_PATH:-}\"; done","echo \"NODE_PATH=${NODE_PATH:-\u003cunset\u003e}\"","ls -d /root/.cache/ms-playwright/* 2\u003e/dev/null || echo 'WARN: no ms-playwright browser cache under /root'","if [ -z \"${NODE_PATH:-}\" ]; then echo 'BLOCKED: RENDERER_MODULE_ABSENT -- node is present and the Chromium build is cached, but no node playwright module was found on this host. Installing one is npm egress off Opal infrastructure (refused at IB-s-8). This refusal is the recorded output; the render did NOT run and nothing was written.'; exit 3; fi","export PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH=\"${PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH:-/root/.cache/ms-playwright}\"","echo '--- render ---'","export IRPT_BUCKET='{{Bucket}}'","export IRPT_BUNDLE_KEY='{{BundleKey}}'","export IRPT_OUTPUT_KEY='{{OutputKey}}'","export IRPT_EXPORT_ID='{{ExportId}}'","export IRPT_ATTEMPT_ID='{{AttemptId}}'","export IRPT_TEMPLATE='{{Template}}'","export IRPT_PRINT_ROUTE='{{PrintRoute}}'","export IRPT_PORTAL_ORIGIN='{{PortalOrigin}}'","export IRPT_RENDER_TOKEN_NAME='{{RenderTokenName}}'","export IRPT_PRINT_QUERY='{{PrintQuery}}'","bash /opt/investor-reporting-export/run-export-render.sh"],"timeoutSeconds":"900"},"name":"renderExport"}],"parameters":{"AttemptId":{"description":"The attempt id (ATT-...) for THIS render.","type":"String"},"Bucket":{"description":"The evidence bucket.","type":"String"},"BundleKey":{"description":"S3 key of the frozen ExportBundle persisted BEFORE this render.","type":"String"},"ExportId":{"description":"The LOGICAL export id (EXP-...), stable across a byte-identical retry.","type":"String"},"OutputKey":{"description":"S3 key the rendered report.pdf is written to.","type":"String"},"PortalOrigin":{"description":"The Opal portal origin the print route is served from. NEVER a vendor origin -- the host refuses one before the browser opens.","type":"String"},"PrintQuery":{"default":"","description":"The print URL query: bundle, tenant, revision, kind, selection, start, end -- issued ids and dates only.","type":"String"},"PrintRoute":{"default":"/investor-reporting/print","description":"The counterpart's print entry point route.","type":"String"},"RenderTokenName":{"default":"","description":"Parameter Store name of this attempt's render token (/irpt/render-token/ATT-...). The value is read and deleted on the host; it never appears in this command.","type":"String"},"Template":{"default":"performance-landscape-letter","description":"The package template name.","type":"String"}},"schemaVersion":"2.2"}
values.description: Render ONE IRPT export: read the frozen ExportBundle from S3, open the counterpart's print route in Chromium, write the PDF and the network guard log back under the bound firm's exports prefix. NOT a vendor call: the only origin opened is the Opal portal origin, and a vendor origin is refused before the browser opens.
